text:
amelia: heads-up: proposal to extend retention for security triage snapshots from 30d -> 90d but only for snapshots tagged `triage=true`. need an access workflow (RBAC + KMS) thats safe and oncall-friendly.

chao: RBAC: create `roles/siem.temporaryViewer` with condition on resource.labels.triage == 'true' and issue short-lived bindings (4h). infra can automate.

infra: automation plan: ticket triggers a lambda that creates a time-bound IAM binding and records the grant in `sec-audit`. revoke is scheduled.

amelia: KMS unwrap? can't require engineers to manually unwrap.

kms-bot: policy: all unwrap requests must go through `kms-proxy` with require_ticket=true and unwrap_ttl=4h. webhook posts to `sec-audit` with ticket_id and requester.

oncall: flow suggestion: analyst files ticket -> minimal approval rules (oncall auto-approve if P1/P2 owner ack) -> ephemeral IAM binding + KMS unwrap -> access. logs emitted to audit stream.

chao: also add pre-export scrub for any snapshot that leaves internal access and store a KMS-wrapped digest for integrity checks.

amelia: I'll draft the policy and runbook, include legal note for 90d opt-in. linking PR when ready.

infra: small test in staging first. I'll schedule smoke test to verify bindings, unwrap logs, and scrubbed export checks.

oncall: approved the approach in principle. will finalize acceptance criteria.
